title: Emergency Chlorine Bleach Water Disinfection (Guideline 1)
trigger_symptoms: purify dirty water with bleach in Sector B

summary: Precision household chlorine bleaching ratio and contact-time validation. Adheres to Sphere Humanitarian Standards.

title: SODIS (Solar Water Disinfection) in PET Plastic Bottles (Guideline 2)
trigger_symptoms: disinfect water with sun bottles in relief shelter 2

summary: Solar ultraviolet-A disinfection protocol for fuel-depleted disaster zones. Adheres to Sphere Humanitarian Standards.
